consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the atmosphere at the concert was electric, with memorable moments such as the biker riding through the crowd and the weather clearing up as the Dead took the stage. While some felt the performance was not as high-energy as earlier shows, many cherished the experience and the unique vibe of the day.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.4 for 49 reviews + 0.5 sentiment: While many fans enjoyed the concert and had a great time, there were also comments about the performance being lower energy compared to previous shows, leading to a mixed overall sentiment.
